title: docs: two sample transcripts still print the pre-#4409 per-concern step list that the author-time rule registry collapsed into one line
body:
Filed unassigned while fixing #9034 (the stale author-time rule count in the `os validate` transcript on `validating-metadata.mdx`). Same defect class, two different pages, and out of that card's scope — it is scoped to one fenced block on one page. ⛔ No `domain:*` set — triage's single-producer field.

## Measured

`#4409` collapsed the per-concern authoring checks into one registry (`AUTHORING_RULES`), so the three authoring commands now print **one** step for the whole table. Two sample transcripts still reproduce the step list from before that change.

Measured against `origin/main` @ `8640fb268`, by building the CLI and running it on `examples/app-todo`.

### 1. `content/docs/deployment/cli.mdx:398-420` — the `os compile` output example

Shown:

```
  → Validating protocol compliance...
  → Validating expressions (ADR-0032)...
  → Checking dashboard widget bindings (ADR-0021)...
  → Checking dashboard action references (ADR-0049)...
  → Checking SDUI styling (ADR-0065)...
  → Checking security posture (ADR-0090 D7)...
  → Collecting package docs (ADR-0046)...
  → Writing artifact...
```

Real run (`node packages/cli/bin/run.js compile` in `examples/app-todo`):

```
  → Validating protocol compliance...
  → Running author-time rules (41)...
  → Checking capability providers (#3366)...
  → Collecting package docs (ADR-0046)...
  → Writing artifact...
```

So five of the listed steps no longer exist as steps (they are entries in the registry the one line reports), and **`→ Checking capability providers (#3366)...` is missing from the sample entirely**. The authority is `packages/cli/src/commands/compile.ts` — its `printStep` calls are the complete list.

### 2. `content/docs/getting-started/build-with-claude-code.mdx:229-243` — the failing `os validate` example

Shown:

```
  → Validating against ObjectStack Protocol...
  → Validating expressions (ADR-0032)...

  ✗ Expression validation failed (1 issue)
  • stack · action 'resolve_ticket' visible: bare reference `status` — ...
      source: `status != "resolved"`
```

`packages/cli/src/commands/validate.ts` has exactly five `printStep` calls and none of them is `Validating expressions (ADR-0032)`; an expression finding now arrives through the registry, and the failure header the code prints is

```js
printError(`Author-time rules failed (${ruleErrors.length} issue${ruleErrors.length > 1 ? 's' : ''})`);
for (const f of ruleErrors.slice(0, 50)) {
  console.log(`  • ${f.where}: ${f.message}`);
  console.log(chalk.dim(`      ${f.hint}`));
  console.log(chalk.dim(`      rule: ${f.rule}  at ${f.path}`));
}
```

— i.e. `✗ Author-time rules failed (1 issue)`, and each finding carries a `hint` line and a trailer of the form `rule: RULE_ID  at PATH` rather than a `source:` line.

Note this transcript is the one `validating-metadata.mdx` sends readers to **for the bare-reference example verbatim** ("see [the gate in action](/docs/getting-started/build-with-claude-code#4-the-gate-os-validate-catches-ai-mistakes) for the bare-reference example verbatim"). The word `verbatim` is load-bearing there, and it is currently not true.

### Also, on both pages: a missing blank line

Both pages' clean-run snippets print the manifest line immediately followed by `Data: …`. `validate.ts` prints a blank line between them unconditionally whenever a manifest exists (the `console.log('')` after the optional description). Fixed in the `validating-metadata.mdx` block by the #9034 PR; still present on these two pages.

## Why this is worth fixing rather than eliding

Same reasoning the #9034 dispatch settled on: a count or a step list **in prose** is the author's assertion, so eliding an unaccountable one is honest — but **in a transcript it is a reproduction of program output**, and deleting it manufactures output the CLI will never emit. These blocks should be re-derived from a real run, not trimmed.

## For triage

- **Dedupe**: searched open issues at 09:2xZ for stale-sample-output / `cli.mdx` output-example drift — nothing open. #7465 is the closed precedent for exactly this class on `cli.mdx` (a stale rule count plus a retired rule still listed).
- **Scope**: `content/docs/deployment/cli.mdx` and `content/docs/getting-started/build-with-claude-code.mdx`. Docs-only. Whoever takes it should re-run the commands rather than hand-editing, and should check the other `os *` output examples on `cli.mdx` in the same pass.
- **Not a CLI bug** — the CLI's output is correct; the docs are behind it.
- `content/docs/releases/**` stays out of scope as always.
- Backlink: found while implementing #9034.
